in_hebrew.name: פקיטה
in_hebrew.meaning: זעירא ד' אלוקים, חביבה לאלוהים, שמחה באלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם פקיטה מקורו בשורשים עבריים ומשמעותו 'זעירא ד' אלוקים' או 'חביבה לאלוהים'. הוא קשור לשמחה ולקרבה לאלוהים, ומהווה ברכה להורים ולמשפחה. השם משקף את האמונה והתקווה בקשר עם האל.

in_greek.name: Πακιτα
in_greek.meaning: Χαρά στο Θεό, Αγαπητή στο Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Πακιτα έχει σχέση με την χαρά και την αγάπη προς τον Θεό. Στην παράδοση Χριστιανική, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει την πνευματική χαρά και την εγγύτητα με τον Θεό. Είναι ένα όνομα που φέρνει ευλογία και χαρά στην οικογένεια.

in_latin.name: Paquita
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Paquita originem habet in vocabulis Latinis et Hispanicis, significans 'gaudium in Deo' vel 'dilecta Deo'. In traditione Christiana, hoc nomen exprimit gaudium spirituale et propinquitatem ad Deum. Est nomen quod benedictionem et laetitiam familiae affert.

in_english.name: Paquita
in_english.meaning: Little one of God, beloved by God, joy in God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Paquita originates from Hebrew and Spanish roots, meaning 'little one of God' or 'beloved by God'. It signifies spiritual joy and closeness to God. In Christian tradition, Paquita represents a blessing and a source of happiness for families. The name carries a rich history and deep spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Paquita has a rich cultural history, especially in Latin America where it is quite common. It is a term of endearment, emphasizing the importance of family and community. In some Filipino areas, it refers to a certain child spirit believed to protect hearth and home.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Paquita can represent the idea of trusting in the protection and care of a higher power in times of hardship. It can also symbolize the belief in the innocence and purity of children, whom many believe are closer to God due to their pure and untainted spiritual nature. The name is a reminder of the importance of faith, hope, and trusting in the goodness of a higher power during times of difficulty and suffering.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Paquita, derived from the native Mexican name "Paquita Maria," means "little Mary" in English. This name symbolizes the deep reverence and devotion to the Virgin Mary, emphasizing faith, humility, and the nurturing love of God towards His people.
